instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, responsive website for 'Sollmarine' (a premium seafood restaurant).
The primary color palette is Dark Navy, Teal (Sea Wave), White, and Gold Accents.

Implement the Hero section with a full-viewport background image, a dark overlay to ensure text contrast, the slogan 'Свежесть моря в каждом блюде', and two buttons: 'Забронировать стол' (primary gold) and 'Смотреть меню' (secondary outline).
About Section ('О ресторане'): Include a rating of 4.9, 92 guests, VIP-зал, and живая музыка. Use a highly stylized, asymmetric bento layout for these stats.

Menu Section ('Меню'): Highlight 'Рыба и морепродукты' as the main focus. Add categories for Стейки, Пицца, Паста, Рамен, Том-ям, Салаты/супы, Закуски. Avoid standard generic cards; use borderless images with elegant text below.
Delivery Section ('Доставка'): Integrate a shopping cart design/functionality + a WhatsApp CTA.
Amenities Section ('Удобства'): Highlight детское меню, аниматоры, Wi-Fi, and парковка using elegant minimalist icons (e.g., from lucide-react).
Gallery: Create a masonry or bento grid with zero or very tight gaps, displaying the premium food and interior images.
Reviews Section: Emphasize the 4.9 rating. Can use a slick horizontal scroll or standard grid.
Contacts Section: Include a placeholder for a map and mention the bus stop 'Сказка'.
Footer: Add payment options and social media links.
Always use 'data-testid' on interactive elements for automated testing.
